draft.answer: \((x^2-4)/(x-2)=x+2\) for \(x\ne2\). The original domain is \(\mathbb R\setminus\{2\}\). It is not equivalent to \(x+2\) at every real number, because the original expression is undefined at \(x=2\), whereas \(x+2=4\) there.
